correctness.rationale: With generator L=D∂²-D(β-1)x^(−1)∂, the killed Green density is min(x,y)^β y^(1−β)/(Dβ); its jump derivative gives −delta and zero/upper boundary conditions. Integrating y^(p−2) gives E Z_p=x^p/[Dp(β−p)] iff β>p. Strong Markov time-ordering and Tonelli (nonnegative integrands) yield finite mixed moments exactly at β>p+q and divergence at equality, including β≤max(p,q). Subtracting first-moment products gives strictly positive covariance 2x^(p+q)/[D²(β−p)(β−q)(p+q)(β−p−q)]; special case p=q gives variance and Corr formula. Monotonicity follows for p≠q by increasing β−p−q beyond |p−q|. Independently verified the symbolic covariance identity and p=2,q=3,β=7 value 0.8485281374; finite calculations do not prove divergent cases.

Kearney–Martin 2021 computes area–time for Ornstein–Uhlenbeck drift, not inverse-position drift. The exact all-positive-exponent mixed-moment threshold and Pearson monotonicity ceiling are not covered by those inspected statements, although a generic Kac moment or Green-operator recursion can derive the formulas.
